query: I have a spec for migrating our monolith to microservices. The auth module needs to become its own service with its own database, the billing module needs to talk to Stripe via a queue, and we need a shared event bus. Break this down into implementable tasks.

We need to add multi-tenancy to the app. Each tenant gets isolated data, configurable branding, custom domains, and usage-based billing. This touches the database layer, auth, routing, and the admin panel. Plan this out before we start.

Here's the PRD for the new notification system: users can configure email, SMS, and push notifications per event type. There's a preference center UI, a delivery service with retry logic, and template management. Create tasks for implementing this.

I want to implement real-time collaboration in our document editor. We'll need operational transforms or CRDTs, WebSocket connections, cursor presence, conflict resolution, and offline support. This is complex — decompose this feature into phases.

The requirements doc says we need RBAC with custom roles, permission inheritance, resource-level access control, and an audit log. The current system just has admin/user roles hardcoded. Plan the migration from the simple system to full RBAC.

We're adding a plugin system to our CLI tool. Plugins need lifecycle hooks, a registry, dependency resolution, sandboxed execution, and a publish workflow. I have the design doc — help me break this down into ordered tasks with file paths.

I need to implement end-to-end encryption for our chat app. This involves key exchange (X3DH), double ratchet for message encryption, secure key storage, group key management, and device linking. Plan this so I don't miss any security-critical steps.

The tech lead wrote a design for replacing our REST API with GraphQL. We need schema design, resolver implementation for 15 entity types, authentication middleware, N+1 query prevention with dataloaders, and client-side migration. Break this into tasks.

I'm about to start building the search feature — it needs full-text search with Elasticsearch, faceted filtering, autocomplete suggestions, search analytics, and a results ranking algorithm. But I don't have a plan yet. Help me think through the implementation steps.

Here's our API contract for the new inventory management system (OpenAPI spec attached). It has 23 endpoints across 6 resource types, webhook callbacks, batch operations, and idempotency requirements. Create a phased implementation plan with verification at each step.
Can you fix the null pointer exception in src/handlers/order.go on line 134? The order.Customer field is nil when the order comes from the webhook path instead of the API.

Add a loading spinner to the dashboard page. When the API call is in flight, show a centered spinner, and fade in the content when data arrives. Use the existing Spinner component from our UI library.
Review my pull request and tell me if the error handling in the new payment processor looks correct. I'm specifically worried about the retry logic in src/payments/retry.ts.
Write unit tests for the calculateDiscount function in src/pricing/discounts.ts. It needs to handle percentage discounts, fixed amount discounts, stacking rules, and edge cases like negative prices.
I need to plan my vacation next month. Can you help me figure out which days to take off to maximize long weekends around the holidays?
Rename the variable `data` to `userProfile` everywhere in src/components/ProfileCard.tsx. It's used 12 times and the generic name makes the code hard to follow.
What's the best project planning tool for a small team? We're comparing Linear, Jira, and GitHub Projects. We need sprint planning, roadmaps, and integrations with Slack.
Run the database migration script at scripts/migrate.sh and tell me if it completes successfully. If there are errors, show me the relevant log output so I can diagnose.
Explain how the task decomposition algorithm works in src/planner/decompose.ts. I need to understand the recursive splitting logic before I modify it.
Update the README to document the new CLI flags we added: --verbose, --dry-run, and --config. Include usage examples for each one.
